policy: Verified photographs with untouched publisher bytes. Product documents are identity references only; they are not images embedded in the application.

entries.author: Lance Cpl. Jacqueline Parsons
entries.model_review_notes: DVIDS identifies Aeryon SkyRanger. The white center body, four black arms and separate curved white landing legs match the manufacturer-authored SkyRanger R60 product photograph, checked visually. Not the black R70/R80D or an unrelated Sky Ranger aircraft.
entries.visual_review_notes: Whole SkyRanger R60 viewed from below at an oblique angle in flight. Original publisher framing and background retained without editing.
entries.changes: None. Unmodified publisher-hosted rendition; not claimed to be a camera raw original.
